clue.text: Goods vehicle from Germany heads in for repair

parts.note: a Merc is a Mercedes, a car made in Germany

indicators.note: something sent for repair is taken apart and put back together, so these letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A German delivery van is driven in to have its front fixed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heads' looks like the front of the van, but 'for repair' rearranges it with IN to give HANDISE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: merchandise is stock or wares for sale, i.e. goods.

clue.text: The special one needs to see bishop in power

indicators.note: in places the bishop's letters inside the word for power

parts.note: might means strength or power
RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop

explanation.surface: A self-styled special one must meet a senior cleric among the powerful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Special One' was football manager José Mourinho's nickname, a lure away from romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: Mr Right is the ideal partner, the one person who is special to someone.

clue.text: Reliable prisoner loses head, being out of practice

indicators.note: losing the head means the first letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a trusty is a prisoner trusted with privileges

explanation.surface: A trusted inmate is beheaded, having grown out of practice.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: skills that are rusty have deteriorated through lack of use.

clue.text: Arc heroes running in this?

indicators.note: running suggests movement and disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The champions of the Arc (France's great flat race) are competing in this.
explanation.walkthrough: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in Paris is a famous horse race; its winning horses would run in one, so the whole clue defines as well.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Arc is a contest for horses, an event where racehorses gallop.

clue.text: Fix one's heart trouble

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle letter, here of the word one

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: Someone tries to mend their cardiac problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to nail something is to fix it in place, or to fasten it.

clue.text: Dashed, needing time for female domestic

indicators.note: needing one letter for another signals a swap of letters in the word

parts.note: infernal and dashed are both mild curse words meaning damned

explanation.surface: A rushed-off household servant needs time off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needing time for female' swaps the F of INFERNAL for T. 'Dashed' looks like rushing, but is an old exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: domestic affairs are internal ones, inside a country rather than foreign.

clue.text: Supply the essence of Freud, ne'er written up

indicators.note: written up says the hidden letters are read backwards, as in a down entry
the essence is the core, so letters are taken from inside the following words

explanation.surface: A demand to capture the essential Freud, who never wrote anything down.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Supply the essence' as definition and left no word signalling a hidden word; 'the essence of' does that job, leaving 'Supply' as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to endue is to endow or furnish someone with a quality.

clue.text: Cheers up in Kentucky with accomplished sort of cricket

indicators.note: in puts the reversed thanks inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: KY is the postal abbreviation for Kentucky

indicators.note: up in a down entry means the letters read upwards, backwards

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, like cheers
did means carried out or accomplished

explanation.surface: Raising a glass in Kentucky after a skilled kind of cricket match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheers' gives TA, British thanks; 'up' turns it to AT. The cricket here is the insect, not the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a katydid is a North American bush cricket, the insect named for its call.

clue.text: Suitable place to the south of a quiet river in Italy

indicators.note: in a down entry the word for place comes below the earlier letters

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical abbreviation for quiet
the Po is Italy's longest river
a site is a place or location

explanation.surface: A good spot below a calm Italian river.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something apposite is apt, well suited to the occasion.

clue.text: Pause, welcoming coach's check

indicators.note: welcoming means the word for pause takes the other word inside it

parts.note: a rest is a pause
to coach is to train someone

explanation.surface: A break is called while the coach's check is under way.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: restraint is a check or curb on action.

clue.text: Exile must lose right to get storage facility

indicators.note: losing a letter means it is taken out of the word

parts.note: to deport is to expel or exile

explanation.surface: A banished person has to give up the right to a warehouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a depot is a warehouse or storehouse for goods.

clue.text: Report of bloke seeing natural water feature

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the word is spoken and its sound used

parts.note: geezer is British slang for a man, a bloke

explanation.surface: An account of a man spotting a hot spring.
explanation.walkthrough: Said the British way, geyser rhymes with geezer.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a geyser is a spring that erupts hot water and steam, a natural feature.

clue.text: Succeed in cadging exotic fedora worn by the Spanish

indicators.note: worn by places the article inside the rearranged hat
exotic means strange or foreign, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A Spaniard sporting an unusual hat manages to scrounge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' gives FREOAD; the definition stretches cadging to cover the success of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to freeload is to live off others by scrounging, cadging successfully.

clue.text: Violent type joining couple of sailors

indicators.note: a couple of means two, so the word is written twice

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A thug teams up with a pair of seamen.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a tartar is a fierce, intractable person, from the Tatar warriors.

clue.text: Investigate hearse crashing when circling about by river

indicators.note: circling means the rearranged letters go round the others
crashing suggests wreckage, so these letters are rearranged
by means next to, joining the two short pieces

parts.note: C, circa, is the abbreviation for about

explanation.surface: Look into a hearse that crashed while driving around by a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashing' turns HEARSE into RESEAH, round RC.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to research a matter is to study and investigate it.

clue.text: Cooler time for person of conviction?

parts.note: the cooler is slang for prison
bird is British slang for prison time, from rhyming slang bird-lime

explanation.surface: Someone with strong convictions is having a cold spell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Person of conviction' means not a believer but a convict.
explanation.definitionFit: Pun: a convicted criminal is someone with a conviction, an old lag.

clue.text: Beast set up trend, oddly having put a film on

indicators.note: set up in a down entry means the word reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: a beast is an animal

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third and fifth letters

explanation.surface: An animal starts a strange fashion by covering itself in film.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: laminated means coated with a thin protective layer of plastic.

clue.text: Relations camp without protection in America

parts.note: uncles are relations

indicators.note: the outer letters protect a word, so dropping them leaves its middle

explanation.surface: Family members camp out unprotected in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: Personification: Uncle Sam is the bearded figure who stands for the United States.

clue.text: Bill's to be inclusive of new gates

indicators.note: being inclusive of means the word holds the other letter inside

parts.note: a bill is a poster, so the plural gives posters

explanation.surface: A bill is drafted to cover newly built gates.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: posterns are back or side gates, especially in a castle wall.

clue.text: Bed, and public relations work for a supporter of mine!

parts.note: pit is British slang for bed
op, short for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: A cheerful plug for a bed: just the thing for my backer!
explanation.walkthrough: 'mine' looks like the possessive, but is a coal mine.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a pit prop is a timber post holding up the roof of a mine tunnel.

clue.text: A doctor with English degree and simple kind of life

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a degree

explanation.surface: A doctor holding an English degree leads an unfussy life.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an amoeba is a single-celled organism, a basic life form.

clue.text: Increase production of gunmetal endlessly

indicators.note: a production reworks material into something new, so these letters are rearranged
endlessly means the last letter is cut off the word

explanation.surface: Making a never-ending supply of gunmetal grows output.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to augment something is to enlarge or add to it.

clue.text: Works hard getting a victory in track sports, initially

indicators.note: in places the short pieces inside the word for track

parts.note: a trail is a track or path

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: An athlete trains hard and wins at track events.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to travail is to toil, labour or work hard.

clue.text: A flavouring, mostly jelly

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: spice is a flavouring

explanation.surface: A seasoning, chiefly used in jelly.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: aspic is a savoury jelly made from meat stock.

clue.text: A French star — good but not recognised

parts.note: un is French for a
the sun is a star

explanation.surface: A French celebrity is fine yet overlooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: unsung means unacclaimed, not celebrated or praised.

clue.text: Make one section of carpet in Uxbridge to be sent north

indicators.note: sent north in a down entry means the letters read upwards, backwards
a section is a part, so the letters lie inside the following words

explanation.surface: A piece of carpet bought in Uxbridge (a west London suburb) is to be dispatched north.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to unite things is to join them into a single whole.

clue.text: Jumper found in this sort of market?

definitions.meaning: an insect that leaps, here not a sweater
a market selling cheap second-hand goods

explanation.surface: A sweater turns up at a bargain stall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumper' suggests a British sweater, but it is a leaping insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Dual sense: a leaping parasite, and the kind of junk market named after it.

clue.text: Go through again having regard to limit

parts.note: re means with regard to, concerning
a cap is an upper limit

explanation.surface: Revisit, bearing a ceiling in mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to recap is to summarise, running over the main points once more.

clue.text: Only receiving Italian broadcast for game

indicators.note: receiving means the word takes the others inside it

parts.note: sole means only
to air a programme is to broadcast it

explanation.surface: Only an Italian broadcast is being picked up for the match.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: solitaire is a card or peg game for one player.

clue.text: One of ten damn changes — make a remark about that

indicators.note: about means the word goes around the other letters

parts.note: to comment is to make a remark

indicators.note: changes signals that these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone swears at many changes and wants to comment on them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' gives ANDM. The ten are the biblical Ten Commandments, and swearing breaks one.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: each commandment is one of the ten laws Moses received.
